title: Rural Home Loans Late Charge Rate Table by Recent Late Charges
content:
On Rural Home Loans, the late charge rate applied to a late monthly payment depends on the late charges that count against the loan.

## Late charges that count

The late charges that count toward the late charge rate are the late charges assessed on the home loan in the twelve months up to today less the late charge waivers recorded on the home loan in those twelve months, whether granted as an error correction or as a courtesy, since a waived charge is not held against the member. The twelve months up to today run from the day after the same calendar day twelve months before today through today, by the date on each late-charge entry and each waiver entry.

## Rate table

| Late charges that count | Late charge rate |
|---|---|
| none | 3 percent |
| exactly one | 4 percent |
| two or more | the product's late charge percentage |

The rate is a percentage applied to the amount on which the late charge is measured.

## Worked counts (hypothetical ledgers)

| Late charges assessed in the twelve months | Late-charge waivers recorded in the twelve months | Count | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | none | 3 percent |
| 1 | 1 (courtesy) | none | 3 percent |
| 1 | 1 (error correction) | none | 3 percent |
| 2 | 1 | exactly one | 4 percent |
| 1 | 0 | exactly one | 4 percent |
| 3 | 1 | two | the product's late charge percentage |

A late charge assessed thirteen months before today is outside the twelve months and does not enter the count.
